item.title: 库克现身广州，探班 iPhone 18 Pro 咏春短片拍摄现场
item.guid: 库克现身广州，探班-iPhone-18-Pro-咏春短片拍摄现场
item.description:
On October 10, Apple's Executive Chairman Tim Cook returned to China, choosing Guangzhou as his first stop to visit the set of a Wing Chun-themed short film shot with the iPhone 18 Pro series. 10 月 10 日，苹果董事会执行主席蒂姆·库克（Tim Cook）再次来到中国，并将此行首站选在广州，探班使用 iPhone 18 Pro 系列拍摄的咏春主题短片。

The filming involved young director Gu Tianji and Wing Chun inheritor Dai Zilong, showcasing traditional Chinese martial arts through mobile phone imagery in a real Lingnan-style garden. 拍摄由青年导演古天鸡与咏春拳传承人戴子龙参与，在岭南风格的园林实景中，通过手机影像呈现中国传统武术。

During the visit, Cook watched a Wing Chun demonstration and discussed mobile videography and professional workflows with the creative team. It is reported that the filming team utilized the iPhone 18 Pro series' camera system to capture rapidly changing Wing Chun moves in low-light conditions. Additionally, Gu Tianji's team also showed Cook a "martial arts manual" drawn with an iPad Pro and Apple Pencil Pro, presenting Wing Chun techniques through digital painting. 探班期间，库克现场观看了咏春拳演示，并与主创团队交流移动影像拍摄及专业工作流程。据介绍，拍摄团队利用 iPhone 18 Pro 系列的摄像头系统，在低光环境下记录快速变化的咏春招式。此外，古天鸡团队还向库克展示了一份使用 iPad Pro 搭配 Apple Pencil Pro 绘制的「武功秘籍」，以数字绘画的形式呈现咏春拳法。

Cook later stated on social media: "So glad to be back in China! Experiencing the charm of Wing Chun through the iPhone 18 Pro lens for the first time in Guangzhou was truly an unforgettable experience." 库克随后在社交平台表示：「很高兴再次来到中国！在广州第一次透过 iPhone 18 Pro 镜头感受咏春的魅力，真是一次难忘的体验。」

It is worth noting that this is Cook's first visit to China since stepping down as Apple CEO and becoming Executive Chairman of the Board in September this year. Apple's current CEO is John Ternus. 值得一提的是，这是库克今年 9 月卸任苹果 CEO、转任董事会执行主席后首次到访中国。苹果现任 CEO 为约翰·特努斯（John Ternus）。

item.title: 曝苹果 iPhone Duo 加单 30%，Pro 系列总订单量不变
item.guid: 曝苹果-iPhone-Duo-加单-30%，Pro-系列总订单量不变
item.description:
According to Securities Times, Apple has made structural adjustments to its orders for new phones this autumn: iPhone Duo orders increased by 30%, but the adjusted total still does not exceed 10 million units. 据证券时报报道，苹果对今年秋季新款手机的订单作出结构性调整：iPhone Duo 加单 30%，调整后的总量仍未超过 1000 万台。

Meanwhile, iPhone 18 Pro orders decreased by 10% to 15%, while iPhone 18 Pro Max orders increased by 10% to 15%, keeping the total order volume for the Pro series unchanged. The report cited Apple supply chain sources saying that the order structure is shifting towards higher-value products, which is expected to benefit the performance of related supply chain companies. 与此同时，iPhone 18 Pro 订单减少 10% 至 15%，iPhone 18 Pro Max 订单增加 10% 至 15%，Pro 系列总订单量保持不变。报道援引苹果供应链人士称，订单结构正向价值更高的产品倾斜，预计有利于相关供应链公司的业绩。

item.title: 苹果第二期中国清洁能源基金扩容至 2.12 亿美元
item.guid: 苹果第二期中国清洁能源基金扩容至-2.12-亿美元
item.description:
On October 10, Apple announced that the total committed investment for the second phase of its China Clean Energy Fund has increased to $212 million, approximately 1.4 billion RMB. Suppliers such as ATL, Zhen Ding Technology, and Darfon Technology have joined as contributors. The fund has completed initial investments, supporting two wind power projects in Guangxi (260 MW) and Shandong (50 MW), both of which have commenced construction. 10 月 10 日，苹果宣布第二期中国清洁能源基金的承诺投资总额增至 2.12 亿美元，约合 14 亿元人民币。新能源科技、鹏鼎控股与达尔科技等供应商加入出资，基金已完成初步投资，支持广西 260 兆瓦、山东 50 兆瓦两处风电项目，均已开工建设。

Apple also announced that over 95% of its direct manufacturing in China now uses renewable energy, with the goal of fully utilizing renewable energy across its global supply chain by the end of 2030. The second phase of the fund, managed by Schroders Capital, plans to add 1.1 million megawatt-hours of wind and solar power generation capacity to China's grid annually. 苹果同时公布，其在中国超过 95% 的直接生产制造现已采用可再生能源，目标是到 2030 年底在全球供应链全面使用可再生能源。由施罗德资本管理的第二期基金，计划每年为中国电网新增 110 万兆瓦时的风能和太阳能发电能力。

In terms of industrial heating emission reduction, Apple is collaborating with Shandong Innovation Precision to advance the electrification of aluminum smelting, applying the demonstrated electric induction furnace technology to the mass production of MacBook Air. Apple will also provide new grants to the China Green Carbon Foundation and the Friends of Nature Public Welfare Foundation in Beijing, supporting forest and urban carbon sink pilots and community climate change response programs, respectively. 在工业供热减排方面，苹果正与山东创新精密推进铝材熔炼电气化，将已完成示范运行的电感应炉技术用于 MacBook Air 规模化生产。苹果还将向中国绿色碳汇基金会和北京自然之友公益基金会提供新资助，分别支持森林与城市碳汇试点、社区应对气候变化方案。

item.title: 四部门拟禁全隐藏式车门把手，要求车企如实宣传使用边界
item.guid: 四部门拟禁全隐藏式车门把手，要求车企如实宣传使用边界
item.description:
On October 10, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and three other departments released a draft notice for public comment on the management of innovative design and R&D testing and verification for automotive products. It proposes to prohibit fully concealed door handles and requires car manufacturers to conduct marketing promotions truthfully and objectively, accurately explaining the usage boundaries, restrictions, and test verification status of innovative designs. 10 月 10 日，工业和信息化部等四部门发布汽车产品创新设计和研发测试验证管理通知征求意见稿，拟禁止配备全隐藏式门把手，并要求车企真实、客观开展营销宣传，如实说明创新设计的使用边界、限制条件和测试验证情况。

The draft notice addresses issues such as blindly launching new products and insufficient testing and verification, putting forward requirements: emergency controls involving safety should retain physical controls and prominent markings; door handles must have mechanical redundancy design and hand operating space, and their operability in extreme environments and emergencies must be verified. Functions such as "zero gravity" seats, swivel seats, or seats folding into beds are not allowed while driving. 征求意见稿针对跟风推出新产品、测试验证不充分等问题提出要求：涉及安全的应急操纵件应保留实体操纵件和醒目标识；门把手须具备机械冗余设计和手部操作空间，并验证极端环境及紧急情况下的可操作性。行车时不可使用「零重力」座椅、旋转座椅或座椅放倒成床等功能。

According to the proposed arrangement, starting from January 1, 2027, newly declared products involving innovative designs must supplement technical parameters and complete corresponding tests; products that have already received approval should submit supplementary parameters and verification materials before July 1, 2027. The environmental adaptability verification period shall not be less than 1 year, and reliability verification tests shall not be less than 30,000 kilometers. 按拟议安排，2027 年 1 月 1 日起，涉及创新设计的新申报产品需补充技术参数并完成相应测试；已取得公告的产品应在 2027 年 7 月 1 日前补报参数及验证材料。环境适应性验证周期不少于 1 年，可靠性验证试验不低于 3 万公里。

Regarding promotion, car manufacturers must not engage in false, exaggerated, or misleading advertising, must not use scenarios that violate road traffic regulations to demonstrate product functions, nor must they induce drivers to neglect their safe driving responsibilities. The above requirements are currently in the public consultation phase. 宣传方面，车企不得作虚假、夸大或引人误解的宣传，不得使用违反道路交通法规的场景展示产品功能，也不得诱导驾驶人忽视安全驾驶责任。上述要求目前处于公开征求意见阶段。

item.title: 字节据报加速个人 AI 智能体，拟将 Spell 与豆包结合
item.guid: 字节据报加速个人-AI-智能体，拟将-Spell-与豆包结合
item.description:
According to Caixin, ByteDance is accelerating the development of personal AI agents, planning to combine the project codenamed Spell with its Doubao product for an external launch as soon as possible. Caixin learned from ByteDance insiders on October 9 that this R&D had been expedited before the National Day holiday. 据财新报道，字节跳动正在加快个人 AI 智能体的研发，计划把代号为 Spell 的项目与豆包产品结合，尽快对外推出。财新 10 月 9 日从字节内部人士处获悉，这项研发在国庆假期前已加紧推进。

The Spell project was launched in April this year, continuing the exploration of personal AI agents by Doubao Mobile Assistant in 2025. At that time, internal product testing for related products had already begun within Doubao. Spell 项目于今年 4 月启动，延续了 2025 年豆包手机助手在个人智能体方向上的探索。彼时，豆包内部已启动相关产品内测。

The report states that the new product is led by the Doubao Mobile Assistant team, with the Spell project and Doubao Dialogue team jointly responsible. After personal AI agents like Meta Muse gained popularity overseas, ByteDance further accelerated the project's progress. 报道介绍，新产品由豆包手机助手团队主导，Spell 项目与豆包对话团队共同负责。Meta Muse 等个人智能体在海外走红后，字节进一步加快了项目进度。

item.title: Meta 据报暂缓向 Anthropic 提供 AI 算力
item.guid: Meta-据报暂缓向-Anthropic-提供-AI-算力
item.description:
According to The Wall Street Journal, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called Meta's Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang earlier this year, seeking more computing power. After internal discussions, Meta ultimately decided not to provide chip computing power to Anthropic for the time being. 据《华尔街日报》报道，Anthropic 首席执行官 Dario Amodei 今年早些时候曾致电 Meta 首席 AI 官 Alexandr Wang，寻求更多算力。Meta 内部讨论后，最终决定暂时不向 Anthropic 提供芯片算力。

The unexpected popularity of Claude Code led to Anthropic facing computing power shortages and frequent service interruptions. To find resources, co-founder Tom Brown visited xAI's office in late March to negotiate with Elon Musk; Anthropic subsequently announced an agreement with SpaceX in May to lease over 300 megawatts of computing power. Claude Code 的意外走红让 Anthropic 遭遇算力紧张，并导致服务频繁中断。为寻找资源，联合创始人 Tom Brown 在 3 月底到 xAI 办公室与马斯克商谈；Anthropic 随后于 5 月宣布与 SpaceX 达成协议，租用超过 300 兆瓦算力。

Reports indicate that a large number of data centers are still under construction, and the currently available capacity is far less than the announced scale. Mature suppliers are beginning to demand multi-year contracts and higher advance payments, while some startups are turning to service providers with weaker security or infrastructure. Some companies are also overbooking to guard against future shortages, while others are forced to resell surplus capacity due to lower-than-expected product demand. 报道指出，大量数据中心仍处于建设阶段，眼下可实际使用的容量远少于宣布中的规模。成熟供应商开始要求多年合同和更高预付款，一些初创公司则转向安全或基础设施较弱的服务商。还有公司为防备未来短缺而超额预订，也有公司因产品需求不及预期，被迫转售剩余容量。

item.title: Netflix 称约 300 部作品已使用 AI，导演谈降本与创作取舍
item.guid: Netflix-称约-300-部作品已使用-AI，导演谈降本与创作取舍
item.description:
Lee Sung-gyun, Senior Director of Production for Netflix Asia Pacific, stated at a forum during the Busan International Film Festival that the company has used AI in various ways for approximately 300 works, with applications including pre-visualization, art design, set conceptualization, editing, and visual effects. Netflix 亚太制作高级总监 Lee Sung-gyun 在釜山国际电影节论坛上表示，公司约有 300 部作品已以不同方式使用 AI，应用环节包括预演、美术设计、布景构思、剪辑和视觉特效。

According to Variety's on-site report, Netflix showcased its Eyeline studio's hybrid production process, combining live-action, traditional special effects, and generative tools. The Indian production "Glory" also used AI and visual effects to complete large crowd scenes; Lee stated that these shots might have been abandoned under the original budget and timeline. 据 Variety 现场报道，Netflix 展示了旗下 Eyeline 工作室结合实拍、传统特效和生成工具的混合制作流程。印度作品《Glory》也借助 AI 与视觉特效完成大规模人群场面；Lee 称，在原有预算和工期下，这些镜头本来可能被舍弃。

Kang Yoon-sung, director of "The Outlaws," who was also present, introduced that he used Keling to produce a full AI test film for his maritime military project "The Gulf of Aden." When the team calculated for financing, they estimated that adopting this process could reduce the production budget by about 40%, saving costs from special effects, simplified shooting, and shortened cycles. This is a calculation for a specific project, not a universal cost reduction ratio for completed films. 同场的《犯罪都市》导演姜允成介绍，他为海上军事题材项目《The Gulf of Aden》用可灵制作过全 AI 测试片。团队为融资测算时，预计采用这套流程可将制作预算降低约 40%，节省来自特效、拍摄简化与周期缩短。这是具体项目的测算，并非已完成影片的普遍降本比例。

Kang Yoon-sung also pointed out that AI makes some projects previously canceled due to budget constraints feasible again, but it might also eliminate the process of multi-person discussion, experimentation, and experience accumulation. He believes that while image quality improves, conveying emotions and moving audiences still requires human creativity; Lee also emphasized that the generated results ultimately need to be processed again by humans. 姜允成同时指出，AI 让一些曾因预算取消的项目重新具备可行性，但也可能省去多人讨论、尝试和积累经验的过程。他认为，画面质量虽提升，传达情感、打动观众仍需人的创作；Lee 也强调，生成结果最终需要人再处理一次。

item.title: 长鑫披露 4F² 内存架构进展，首款服务器产品预计年底推出
item.guid: 长鑫披露-4F²-内存架构进展，首款服务器产品预计年底推出
item.description:
Cao Kanyu, President of CXMT, disclosed at the 4th Integrated Chip and Chiplet Conference on October 10 that CXMT expects to launch a new generation of DDR5 RDIMM server memory products using a 4F² architecture by the end of the year. According to Yicai and 21st Century Business Herald, this technology involves adjustments in both storage cell and manufacturing processes. 长鑫存储总裁曹堪宇在 10 月 10 日的第四届集成芯片和芯粒大会上披露，长鑫预计年底推出采用 4F² 架构的新一代 DDR5 RDIMM 服务器内存产品。据第一财经、21 世纪经济报道，这项技术在存储单元和制造工艺两方面作出调整。

Currently, mainstream DRAM storage cells use a 6F² architecture, where F represents the minimum feature size. 4F² reduces the cell area to four times the square of the minimum feature size, increasing storage density per unit area. CXMT uses self-developed VSG (Vertical Surrounding Gate) transistors, arranging them vertically to enhance gate control, improve leakage, and mitigate short-channel effects. 目前 DRAM 主流存储单元采用 6F² 架构，F 代表最小特征尺寸。4F² 将单元面积缩小至四倍最小特征尺寸的平方，提高单位面积的存储密度。长鑫采用自研 VSG 垂直包围沟道晶体管，让晶体管竖立布置，以增强栅极控制能力，改善漏电与短沟道效应。

Another adjustment is to separate the manufacturing processes of the DRAM storage array and the CMOS peripheral logic circuits, and then interconnect them through wafer-level hybrid bonding, allowing for separate optimization of logic performance and storage density. Cao Kanyu stated that CXMT has over 300 related public patent families. 另一项调整是将 DRAM 存储阵列与 CMOS 外围逻辑电路的制造工艺分开，再通过晶圆级混合键合实现互联，使逻辑性能和存储密度可以分别优化。曹堪宇称，长鑫相关公开专利族已超过 300 件。

The first-generation product chosen is DDR5 RDIMM for servers, which requires meeting continuous operation, stability, and compatibility requirements. This disclosure covers research and development progress and product plans for the end of the year. 首代产品选择服务器用 DDR5 RDIMM，这类内存需要满足持续运行、稳定性和兼容性要求。此次披露的是研发进展与年底产品计划。

item.title: 英伟达据报洽谈收购 Reflection AI，也可能追加投资
item.guid: 英伟达据报洽谈收购-Reflection-AI，也可能追加投资
item.description:
According to the Financial Times, citing direct sources, Nvidia is in talks to acquire Reflection AI, a US open-weight model company, or to deepen its investment relationship. Discussions are still in early stages, and a deal could be reached in the coming weeks or fall through, with both parties declining to comment. 据《金融时报》援引直接知情人士报道，英伟达正就收购美国开放权重模型公司 Reflection AI，或进一步加深投资关系展开谈判。磋商仍在早期，交易可能在未来数周达成，也可能告吹，双方均拒绝置评。

Potential options include a full acquisition, additional equity investment, and "acqui-hiring": Nvidia hiring its employees and obtaining technology licenses. Another possibility is providing more chips and computing power. The Financial Times stated that Nvidia has invested $800 million in Reflection, making it one of its largest shareholders; the company was valued at $25 billion during its funding round in March this year. 潜在方案包括完整收购、追加股权投资，以及「收购式招聘」：英伟达聘用其员工并获得技术许可。另一种可能是提供更多芯片和算力。《金融时报》称，英伟达已向 Reflection 投入 8 亿美元，是其最大股东之一；这家公司今年 3 月融资时的估值为 250 亿美元。

Reflection was founded by Misha Laskin and Ioannis Antonoglou, who were involved in the development of Google Gemini. This week, it just launched its first customizable public AI product, running on Nvidia chips. Open-weight models allow users to run and customize them on their own hardware, and Reflection is also a participant in the development of a domestic open model ecosystem in the United States. Reflection 由曾参与 Google Gemini 研发的 Misha Laskin 和 Ioannis Antonoglou 创立，本周刚推出首款可定制的公开 AI 产品，运行在英伟达芯片上。开放权重模型允许用户在自己的硬件上运行并进行定制，Reflection 也是美国发展本土开放模型生态的参与者。

Nvidia already has the Nemotron series of open-weight models. The Financial Times points out that the company currently still lacks its own cutting-edge large-scale models. 英伟达已有 Nemotron 开放权重模型系列。《金融时报》指出，公司目前仍缺少自己的前沿规模模型。

item.title: 💡 东芝人力负责人：AI 改变初级岗位，面试更看重解决问题的过程
item.guid: 💡-东芝人力负责人：AI-改变初级岗位，面试更看重解决问题的过程
item.description:
How do junior recruiters gain experience after AI starts screening resumes? Jason Richard Desentz, Chief Human Resources Officer for Toshiba Americas, stated in an article published in Business Insider that junior positions will remain, but job content and recruitment standards are changing. AI 开始筛选简历之后，初级招聘人员如何积累经验？东芝美洲区首席人力资源官 Jason Richard Desentz 在 Business Insider 刊发的口述文章中表示，初级岗位仍会保留，但工作内容和招聘标准正在变化。

He gave an example: when faced with thousands of resumes, recruiters often stop after reviewing the first few dozen and finding some suitable candidates, potentially missing out on good candidates among the rest. Toshiba has built an AI Bot for recruitment, hoping to shift personnel's time towards confirming needs with managers, designing better questions, and improving the new hire onboarding experience; AI-generated interview guides should also help identify areas for follow-up questions, rather than directly excluding people who could potentially learn the job. 他举例说，面对上千份简历，招聘人员往往看完前几十份、找到一些合适人选就会停下，余下的好候选人可能被漏掉。东芝为招聘建立 AI Bot，希望让人员把时间转向与经理确认需求、设计更好的问题和改善新人入职体验；AI 生成的面试指南也应帮助找到需要追问的地方，而非直接排除可能学会工作的人。

During interviews, Desentz focuses more on how candidates break down problems, use data to support decisions, motivate less engaged team members, and adjust plans when faced with sudden changes in budget or deadlines. Individuals without work experience can also use real-life university experiences to illustrate their thought processes. 面试时，Desentz 更关注候选人如何拆解问题、用数据支持判断、推动没有积极参与的同组成员，以及面对突然变化的预算或任务期限如何调整方案。没有工作经验的人，也可以用大学里的真实经历说明思考过程。

Regarding employee concerns, he advocates acknowledging that work is changing and addressing it with the team. Toshiba started by piloting Bots for repetitive tasks that employees disliked the most and arranged basic AI courses and internal demonstrations. He emphasized giving employees time to experiment and allowing them to make mistakes while learning. 对于员工担忧，他主张承认工作正在变化，带着团队一起应对。东芝从员工最不喜欢的重复事务入手试做 Bot，并安排 AI 基础课程和内部展示。他强调要给员工留出试验时间，允许他们在学习中犯错。

item.title: 腾讯云开源 TeamAI，团队 Skill 可跨 Agent 共享
item.guid: 腾讯云开源-TeamAI，团队-Skill-可跨-Agent-共享
item.description:
Tencent Cloud recently introduced and open-sourced its internally used TeamAI tool, hoping to unify the management of team configurations, skills, and experiences scattered across different AI programming tools through a Git repository. The project uses the MIT license and has provided adaptations for tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and CodeBuddy. 腾讯云近日对外介绍并开源内部使用的 TeamAI 工具，希望把分散在不同 AI 编程工具里的团队配置、Skill 和经验，通过 Git 仓库统一管理。项目采用 MIT 许可证，已提供 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、CodeBuddy 等工具的适配。

TeamAI divides capabilities into three layers: TeamAI 将能力分为三层：

    Team Execution Layer: Centralized release of Skills, Rules, MCP, documentation, and model configurations, allowing members to use the same set of team standards across different Agents; supports synchronizing administrator-published updates in new sessions.

    Team Context Layer: Gathers project knowledge, task experience, and code knowledge graphs, and makes them available for subsequent tasks in forms such as teamwiki.

    Team Improvement Layer: Observes team adoption through usage, session records, and Kanban boards, helping to maintain shared configurations.

The latter two layers are still marked as Beta. Members can continue to use their familiar programming tools, while team shared content is maintained and updated within the same repository. 后两层仍标记为 Beta。成员可以继续使用各自熟悉的编程工具，团队共享内容则在同一仓库内维护和更新。

item.title: 银河战舰 700 上市，先享价 17.98 万元起
item.guid: 银河战舰-700-上市，先享价-17.98-万元起
item.description:
On October 10, the Geely Galaxy Battleship 700 was launched in Hangzhou, offering three power options and six models. The introductory two-wheel drive Explorer edition has a pre-sale guide price of 179,800 yuan, and a limited-time renewal price of 169,800 yuan after factoring in trade-in subsidies. 10 月 10 日，吉利银河战舰 700 在杭州上市，共推出三种动力、六款车型。入门两驱探索版先享指导价为 17.98 万元，叠加置换补贴后的限时焕新价为 16.98 万元。

The new car is based on the GTA native new energy off-road architecture, embedding an integrated frame into the body, and features a five-seat layout across all models. The power and chassis are layered by version: 新车基于 GTA 原生新能源越野架构，将一体式大梁嵌入车身，全系采用五座布局。动力与底盘按版本分层：

    The 1.5T two-wheel drive version focuses on daily commuting, with a CLTC pure electric range of 305km and a maximum comprehensive range of 1770km.

    The 1.5T three-motor four-wheel drive version has a combined power of 690kW, accelerating from 0 to 100 km/h in 4.2 seconds; the 2.0T three-motor four-wheel drive version is boosted to 830kW, accelerating from 0 to 100 km/h in 3.95 seconds, and is equipped with low-speed four-wheel drive and a rear mechanical differential lock.

    The Land Ark version further adds active hydraulic suspension, emergency floating escape, and an oxygen generation system.

All models are equipped with a 47.14kWh CATL lithium iron phosphate battery, supporting peak 6C fast charging. The cockpit features Flyme Auto 2, retaining physical gear levers and off-road function buttons, with front and rear seat ventilation and heating as standard; an official roof tent expansion solution is also provided. 全系配备 47.14kWh 宁德时代磷酸铁锂电池，支持峰值 6C 快充。座舱采用 Flyme Auto 2，保留实体挡杆与越野功能按键，前后排座椅通风、加热为标配；官方还提供车顶帐篷拓展方案。

This limited-time launch offer requires users to complete the final order lock, balance payment, and vehicle pickup before October 31, with separate applicable conditions for trade-in subsidies. 本次限时上市权益要求用户在 10 月 31 日前完成大定锁单、尾款支付和提车，置换补贴另有适用条件。

item.title: 阿里升级 NBA Chat，赛事回放可在 10 至 15 秒内生成
item.guid: 阿里升级-NBA-Chat，赛事回放可在-10-至-15-秒内生成
item.description:
NBA China Games 2026 kicked off in Macao, China, on October 9. Alibaba announced that NBA Chat, an intelligent basketball assistant built on Qianwen, has been upgraded to multimodal interaction, supporting voice queries, text and video replies, and is integrated with the NBA knowledge graph and video media asset library. NBA 中国赛 2026 于 10 月 9 日在中国澳门开赛。阿里巴巴介绍，基于千问打造的智能篮球助手 NBA Chat 已升级为多模态交互，支持语音提问、文字及视频回复，并接入 NBA 知识图谱和视频媒资库。

NBA Chat also launched three character-based Agents, adopting the styles of Stephon Marbury, commentator Wang Meng, and basketball anchor Meina, providing interaction, commentary, and post-game information. The 360-degree real-time replay technology, first used in NBA games last year, now includes "Hero Moments": supported by the Wan3.0 video and image generation model, it focuses on offensive and defensive players, generating a surround replay within 10 to 15 seconds. NBA Chat 同时上线三个角色化 Agent，分别采用马布里、解说员王猛和篮球主播美娜的风格，提供互动、解说及赛后资讯。去年首次用于 NBA 赛场的 360 度实时回放技术，今年加入「主角时刻」：由 Wan3.0 视频与图像生成模型支持，聚焦攻防球员，在 10 至 15 秒内生成环绕回放。

On-site spectators can use their photos to generate Mavericks or Rockets-themed AI videos, and online fans can also use the same feature in the Qianwen App. Taobao 88VIP has become the chief partner of the China Games for the second consecutive year, offering benefits such as ticket lotteries, priority access, front-row seats, customized co-branded merchandise, and player interactions. Amap provides indoor navigation and robot dog tours at the NBA House, and has opened an offline market for its "Street Scan" ranking. 场内观众可用自己的照片生成独行侠或火箭队主题 AI 视频，线上球迷也能在千问 App 使用同款能力。淘宝 88VIP 连续第二年成为中国赛首席合作伙伴，提供门票抽奖、优先通道、前排席位、定制联名周边及球星互动等权益。高德则在 NBA House 提供室内导航、机器狗导览，并开设扫街榜线下市集。

item.title: 小米澎湃 OS 4 正式版 10 月 15 日起分批推送
item.guid: 小米澎湃-OS-4-正式版-10-月-15-日起分批推送
item.description:
Xiaomi HyperOS Announcement on October 10 revealed the upgrade schedule: HyperOS 4 official version will be pushed in batches starting from October 15, with the first batch covering models such as Xiaomi 17 series and REDMI K100 Pro series, and then gradually expanding to more existing devices. 小米澎湃 OS 公告君 10 月 10 日公布升级安排：澎湃 OS 4 正式版将于 10 月 15 日起陆续分批推送，首批覆盖 Xiaomi 17 系列、REDMI K100 Pro 系列等机型，之后逐步扩展至更多存量设备。

According to the announcement, the Beta internal test recruitment will end at 12:00 PM on October 14. Users who still wish to participate can register at the Xiaomi Community Internal Test Center and upgrade in "Settings - My Device - System Version" after approval. 据公告，Beta 版内测招募将于 10 月 14 日中午 12 点结束。仍希望参与的用户可在小米社区内测中心报名，通过后在「设置—我的设备—系统版本」中升级。

This official version includes capabilities related to Super Xiaoai 2.0 and the MiMo large model, bringing expert mode, Inspiration Ball interaction, and upgrading cross-device collaboration and system fluidity. 本轮正式版包含超级小爱 2.0 与 MiMo 大模型相关能力，带来专家模式、灵感球交互，并升级跨设备协同与系统流畅度。

item.title: 阿里 Qoder 上线 Fast 模式，首次响应缩短至 3 秒
item.guid: 阿里-Qoder-上线-Fast-模式，首次响应缩短至-3-秒
item.description:
Ali Qoder launched Fast mode on October 10, initially for desktop, requiring an update to version 0.4.4 or higher. Both personal and enterprise editions can use it, with simultaneous support for both Chinese and international versions. 阿里 Qoder 10 月 10 日上线 Fast 模式，率先用于桌面端，需更新至 0.4.4 及以上版本。个人版和企业版均可使用，中国版与国际版同步支持。

The Chinese version adds a new Fast tier, while the international version's existing Performance mode is directly upgraded to Fast, requiring no additional action from existing users. Official data shows that the first response time is reduced from 8 seconds to 3 seconds, and the Credits consumption coefficient drops from 1.1x to 0.8x, a reduction of approximately 27%; it states that the output quality remains unchanged. 中国版新增 Fast 档位，国际版原有的 Performance 模式则直接升级为 Fast，原用户无需额外操作。官方给出的数据是，首次响应时间由 8 秒缩短至 3 秒，Credits 消耗系数由 1.1x 降至 0.8x，约减少 27%；其表示输出质量保持不变。

Other products in the Qoder family are also planned to gradually incorporate Fast mode, with this update currently open first for desktop users. Qoder 产品家族的其他产品也计划陆续加入 Fast 模式，目前这项更新首先面向桌面端开放。

item.title: 罗技预览矩阵式会议音箱，可将两种语言投向不同座区
item.guid: 罗技预览矩阵式会议音箱，可将两种语言投向不同座区
item.description:
Logitech previewed two audio systems, Rally Speaker 2 Pro and Rally Speaker 2 Max, on October 8, entering the professional audiovisual market with its self-developed Sound Shape technology. Both speakers are installed at the front of the room, using 32 and 64 miniature driver units respectively, targeting large conference rooms and training spaces. 罗技 10 月 8 日预览 Rally Speaker 2 Pro 和 Rally Speaker 2 Max 两款音频系统，以自研 Sound Shape 技术进入专业视听市场。两款音箱安装在房间前方，分别使用 32 个和 64 个微型驱动单元，面向大型会议室和培训空间。

This system controls the superposition and cancellation of sound waves, directing sound to designated listening areas while reducing its diffusion towards walls and other directions. Logitech claims this can reduce reflections and echoes, maintain more uniform volume for front and back rows, and lessen the wiring and installation requirements of traditional ceiling speakers. 这套系统通过控制声波的叠加与抵消，把声音投向指定听音区域，同时减少声音向墙壁等方向扩散。罗技称，这可以降低反射和回声，并让前后排保持更均匀的音量，减少传统天花板音箱的布线和安装需求。

Logitech also demonstrated a multi-language solution still under development: a single Max unit can simultaneously project two different audio streams to opposite sides of a room, for example, English on the left and French on the right. The company is working with partners to integrate with Microsoft Teams' Interpreter and Zoom Meetings' Voice Translator. 罗技还演示了一个仍在开发的多语言方案：单台 Max 可同时把两路不同音频投向房间两侧，例如左侧听英语、右侧听法语。公司正与合作伙伴研究接入 Microsoft Teams 的 Interpreter 和 Zoom Meetings 的 Voice Translator。

Both products are currently available for demonstration at Logitech's Silicon Valley Experience Center, with commercial launch planned for summer 2027. 两款产品现可在罗技硅谷体验中心演示，计划于 2027 年夏季商业上市。

item.title: RSIGym 开源，让 AI 自主设计实验、训练并改进模型
item.guid: RSIGym-开源，让-AI-自主设计实验、训练并改进模型
item.description:
The Evolvent AI team open-sourced RSIGym, turning training, inference, evaluation, and sandbox execution into services that AI can call. Research agents design experiments, generate training data, train candidate models, and then adjust their plans based on the results; the platform uniformly manages permissions and budgets, and publishes experiment trajectories. Evolvent AI 团队开源了 RSIGym，把训练、推理、评测和沙箱执行做成 AI 可以调用的服务。研究 Agent 自行设计实验、生成训练数据、训练候选模型，再根据结果调整方案；平台统一管理权限和预算，并公开实验轨迹。

The environment offers three routes: modifying only training data, fixing model weights while changing the execution framework, and simultaneously optimizing data, training settings, and the framework. The main experiment had 6 research agents improve the same starting point across 5 domains: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base plus a minimal execution framework. Each benchmark experiment had a platform service budget of $500, with additional costs for research agent inference and final formal evaluation. 环境提供三种路线：只改训练数据、固定模型权重而改执行框架，以及同时优化数据、训练设置和框架。主实验让 6 个研究 Agent 在 5 个领域中改进同一个起点：Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base 加最小执行框架，每次基准实验的平台服务预算为 500 美元，研究 Agent 推理和最终正式评测费用另计。

The team reported that 29 out of 30 joint optimization experiments outperformed the initial system. Opus 5 achieved the highest RSI-Index of 0.4809, indicating an average compensation of 48.09% of the remaining gap to a perfect score, not the final accuracy. Each research configuration was run only once, and the final evaluation reused tasks visible during the development phase. 团队报告，30 次联合优化实验中有 29 次优于初始系统。Opus 5 的 RSI-Index 最高，为 0.4809，表示平均弥补了距满分剩余差距的 48.09%，并非最终准确率。每种研究配置只运行一次，最终评测复用了开发阶段可见的任务。

Another experiment, where Qwen3.8-27B researched itself, saw a decrease from an initial 56.66% to 56.26%: improvements on a small-scale development set did not translate into an overall enhancement. This result demonstrates the executable process of automated research, while also preserving the boundaries where self-improvement may not always be effective. 另一项让 Qwen3.8-27B 研究自身的实验，则从初始 56.66% 降至 56.26%：小规模开发集上的进步没有转化为整体提升。该结果展示了自动研究的可执行过程，也保留了自我改进未必奏效的边界。

item.title: 2027 款启源 A06 上市，限时权益价 11.69 万元起
item.guid: 2027-款启源-A06-上市，限时权益价-11.69-万元起
item.description:
The 2027 Changan Qiyuan A06 was launched on October 10, offering 5 configurations with official guide prices ranging from 119,900 to 159,900 yuan, and limited-time promotional prices from 116,900 to 156,900 yuan. This facelift adds a "Passionate Red" body color and an 800km long-range version. 2027 款长安启源 A06 于 10 月 10 日上市，共提供 5 款配置，官方指导价从 11.99 万元至 15.99 万元，限时权益价为 11.69 万元至 15.69 万元。此次改款新增「激昂红」车色，并增加 800km 长续航版本。

The new car comes standard with CATL batteries across all models, utilizing an 800V silicon carbide high-voltage platform, supporting 6C flash charging. CLTC pure electric range is available in two tiers: 630km and 800km. According to charging data cited by CNMO, it takes 9 minutes to charge the battery from 30% to 80%. 新车全系标配宁德时代电池，采用 800V 碳化硅高压平台，支持 6C 闪充，CLTC 纯电续航分为 630km 和 800km 两档。CNMO 引述的补能数据为，电量从 30% 充至 80% 需要 9 分钟。

The car's dimensions are 4885×1916×1496mm (length×width×height), with a wheelbase of 2922mm. The chassis features a full-aluminum front double-wishbone and rear five-link suspension. The configuration lineup includes the 630 Comfort Edition, 630 Deluxe Edition, 630 Laser Enjoy Edition, as well as the 800 Laser Long-Range Edition, and 800 Laser Flagship Edition. 车身长宽高为 4885×1916×1496mm，轴距 2922mm，底盘采用全铝前双叉臂加后五连杆悬架。配置序列包括 630 舒享版、630 尊享版、630 激光耀享版，以及 800 激光远航版、800 激光旗舰版。

item.title: lululemon 开启「一起好状态」活动，会发声的乒乓台来到上海
item.guid: lululemon-开启「一起好状态」活动，会发声的乒乓台来到上海
item.description:
lululemon has launched its annual "Feel Good Together" campaign for the sixth consecutive year. On October 7, the first "Experience Day" was held at the Shanghai Conservatory of Music Opera House, where Li Yuchun, Deng Yaping, Paralympic triathlete Wang Jiachao, humanities scholar Liang Yong'an, and mindfulness instructor Jesse Israel discussed well-being across physical, mental, and social dimensions through speeches, dialogues, and breathing practices. lululemon 连续第六年发起「一起好状态」年度活动。10 月 7 日，首场感受日在上海上音歌剧院举行，李宇春、邓亚萍、残奥铁三运动员王家超、人文学者梁永安及正念导师 Jesse Israel，通过演讲、对话和呼吸习练，讨论身体、心理与社交三个维度的好状态。

Artist James de Wulf's "Echoes of Happiness" ping-pong table also made its debut in China. This installation, previously exhibited at Design Miami in Paris in 2025, is made of specially tuned matte aluminum panels, where a ping-pong ball landing on different spots triggers different tones. Deng Yaping and the artist demonstrated this sound interaction by playing on site. 艺术家 James de Wulf 创作的「幸福的回响」乒乓台也首次来到中国。这件曾在 2025 年巴黎 Design Miami 展出的装置，以经过特殊调音的哑光铝板制作，乒乓球落在不同位置时会触发不同音调。邓亚萍与艺术家在现场挥拍演示了这套声音互动。

From October 8 to 18, the ping-pong table will be on temporary display at Shanghai West Bund Central, open for public participation. From October 10 to 17, lululemon will also partner with several venues in Shanghai to offer eight days of themed sweat classes, with a series of classes simultaneously held at stores nationwide. The event extends the dialogues and sports experiences from the Shanghai Conservatory of Music Opera House into the community. 10 月 8 日至 18 日，乒乓台将在上海西岸中环限时展出，公众可参与体验。10 月 10 日至 17 日，lululemon 还将联合上海多家场馆推出八天主题热汗课程，全国门店同步举办系列课程。活动将上音歌剧院的对话与运动体验延伸至社区。

item.title: 七部门发文纠治电商「自动跟价」「全网最低价」竞争
item.guid: 七部门发文纠治电商「自动跟价」「全网最低价」竞争
item.description:
The Ministry of Commerce and six other departments issued a notice on implementing the "Five Excellences" action for quality e-commerce, proposing coordinated efforts to rectify disorderly and irrational competition, correct behaviors such as "automatic price matching" and "lowest price across the network" on e-commerce platforms, and standardize platform commission rates and merchant rating rules to prevent squeezing the survival space of quality merchants. 商务部等七部门发布实施品质电商「五优」行动的通知，提出协同整治无序非理性竞争，纠治电商平台「自动跟价」「全网最低价」等行为，并规范平台佣金抽成、商家评级规则，避免挤压品质商家的生存空间。

The notice requires e-commerce platforms to implement public disclosure of rules and solicit public opinions when formulating or amending them; optimize mechanisms for product display, recommendation, and marketing activities, using product quality, service reputation, and credit information as quality guidance. Relevant departments will also establish dialogue and communication mechanisms between platforms and small and medium-sized businesses, and crack down on fake orders and credit manipulation. 通知要求，电商平台制定、修改规则时，落实规则公示和公开征求意见；优化商品展示、推荐和营销活动机制，将商品质量、服务口碑和信用信息作为品质导向。有关部门还将建立平台与中小商家的对话沟通机制，打击刷单炒信。

Regarding full-link quality control, the notice guides platforms to establish a Chief Quality Officer system, improve the online service quality evaluation system, and support government data verification to assist platforms in comparing merchant licenses. Around consumption nodes like "618" and "Double 11," all parties will strengthen guidance and regulation of platforms. 在全链路品控方面，通知引导平台建立首席质量官制度，完善线上服务质量评价体系，并支持政务数据核验，协助平台比对商家证照。围绕「618」「双 11」等消费节点，各方将加强对平台的指导与规范。

item.title: 胖东来梦之城公示酒店规划，高度不超过 99.95 米
item.guid: 胖东来梦之城公示酒店规划，高度不超过-99.95-米
item.description:
The plans for Pang Dong Lai Dream City's hotel, cultural center, and Happiness Lecture Hall have entered pre-approval public display. Information on construction project planning permits for phases two to four, released by Xuchang Municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau on October 9, shows that the phase four hotel has a planned area of approximately 66,000 square meters and a building height not exceeding 99.95 meters. 胖东来梦之城的酒店、文化中心和幸福讲堂规划进入批前公示。许昌市自然资源和规划局 10 月 9 日公布的二至四期建设工程规划许可信息显示，四期酒店规划面积约 6.6 万平方米，建筑高度不超过 99.95 米。

Among the other two supporting projects, the phase two Happiness Lecture Hall has an area of 5,630 square meters and a height not exceeding 24 meters; the phase three Cultural Center has an area of approximately 36,200 square meters and a height not exceeding 25.45 meters. 另外两个配套项目中，二期幸福讲堂面积 5630 平方米、高度不超过 24 米；三期文化中心面积约 3.62 万平方米、高度不超过 25.45 米。

According to planning information previously disclosed by Jimu News, Phase One of Dream City primarily involves the construction of a commercial complex with a building area of approximately 467,000 square meters and an 8-story main structure. The project is located in Xuchang's Dongcheng District, north of Liancheng Avenue and east of Xuzhou Road, near Xuchang East High-speed Railway Station. 据极目新闻此前披露的规划信息，梦之城一期主要建设商业综合体，建筑面积约 46.7 万平方米，主体共 8 层。项目位于许昌市东城区、莲城大道以北和许州路以东，临近高铁许昌东站。

Yu Donglai stated in July that Dream City would open within 3 years. This public display showcases the planning content for subsequent supporting facilities such as the hotel. 于东来曾在 7 月表示，梦之城将在 3 年内开业。此次公示展示的是酒店等后续配套的规划内容。

item.title: One Fun Thing｜经典 Fiat 500 变身电动海滨小车
item.guid: One-Fun-Thing｜经典-Fiat-500-变身电动海滨小车
item.description:
Italian car customization studio Garage Italia has transformed the classic Fiat 500 Spiaggina into an electric convertible. It retains the beach car design with no doors, an open body, and a removable soft top, targeting yacht users who need short-distance travel in coastal towns after docking in Mediterranean ports. 意大利汽车定制工作室 Garage Italia 把经典 Fiat 500 Spiaggina 改造成了一辆电动敞篷小车。它沿用无车门、开放式车身与可拆卸顶篷的海滨车设定，面向停靠地中海港口后、需要在沿岸小镇短途出行的游艇用户。

According to Design Milk, this car is equipped with an electric motor in the rear, paired with an 11kWh battery, offering a WLTP range of approximately 140 kilometers. Owners can choose from 18 body colors or customize their own; the soft top and seat cushions use fabric from the Italian textile brand Mariaflora, while the handmade Bonacina woven seats are available in wicker or a composite material resistant to sun and salt spray. The floor uses waterproof EVA material. 据 Design Milk 介绍，这辆车在后部装入电动机，搭配 11kWh 电池，WLTP 续航约 140 公里。车主可以选择 18 种车身颜色，也可以定制色彩；顶篷、坐垫采用意大利纺织品牌 Mariaflora 的面料，Bonacina 手工编织的座椅则提供藤编或耐日晒、盐雾的复合材料版本，地板使用防水 EVA 材料。

This modification preserves the original form of the Fiat 500 Jolly, designed for seaside leisure travel. With the power converted to electric drive, yachts no longer need to carry gasoline for it. The vehicle starts at 85,000 euros, with options and taxes extra. 这套改造保留了 Fiat 500 Jolly 当年为海边休闲出行而做的形态，动力改成电驱后，游艇上也无需再为它携带汽油。车辆起价为 8.5 万欧元，选装和税费另计。

item.title: 周末看什么｜《Animals》让一场绑架案撕开竞选家庭的秘密
item.guid: 周末看什么｜《Animals》让一场绑架案撕开竞选家庭的秘密
item.description:
Los Angeles mayoral candidate Mark Kimball is busy with his election campaign when a phone call informs him that his son has been kidnapped. In the Netflix thriller 'Animals,' he and his wife Abigail must raise a ransom, while their marital relationship, campaign interests, and family secrets are successively exposed that night. 洛杉矶市长候选人 Mark Kimball 正在为选举奔忙，一通电话却告知他的儿子遭到绑架。在 Netflix 已上线的惊悚片《Animals》中，他与妻子 Abigail 必须筹措赎金，而夫妻关系、竞选利益与家庭秘密也在这一夜接连暴露。

The film is directed by Ben Affleck, who also stars as Mark. Kerry Washington plays Abigail, Steven Yeun plays the campaign manager, and Gillian Anderson appears as a mysterious broker assisting with the crisis. The story unfolds in Los Angeles, where the public image the campaign team tries to maintain constantly clashes with the family's choices in the kidnapping case. 影片由本·阿弗莱克执导并出演 Mark，凯丽·华盛顿饰演 Abigail，史蒂文·元饰演竞选经理，吉莲·安德森出演协助处理危机的神秘掮客。故事在洛杉矶展开，竞选团队试图维持的公众形象，与一家人在绑架案中的选择不断发生冲突。

Variety film critic Guy Lodge praised the film's tight pacing and Affleck's increasingly out-of-control performance, but also pointed out that the switching between political satire, marital conflict, and popular thriller elements weakened the realism of some plot points. He believes the film maintains its appeal through successive twists but does not fully explore its questioning of power and inequality. Variety 影评人 Guy Lodge 肯定影片紧凑的推进和阿弗莱克逐渐失控的表演，也指出政治讽刺、婚姻冲突与通俗惊悚元素之间的切换，削弱了部分情节的真实感。他认为影片靠接连转折保持吸引力，但没有把对权力和不平等的追问展开到底。

item.title: 买书不读指南｜《创意行为：存在即答案》从注意力谈起
item.guid: 买书不读指南｜《创意行为：存在即答案》从注意力谈起
item.description:
Music producer Rick Rubin, in 'The Creative Act: A Way of Being,' places creation back into everyday observation, perception, and choice. Starting from his experience collaborating with various types of musicians, he discusses how to notice clues, preserve inspiration, conduct experiments, and gradually advance unformed ideas to completion. 音乐制作人里克·鲁宾在《创意行为：存在即答案》中，把创作放回日常的观察、感知和选择。他以自己与不同类型音乐人合作的经验为起点，讨论怎样留意线索、保存灵感、进行试验，以及把尚未成形的想法逐步推进到完成。

The book consists of 78 reflections, covering topics such as beginner's mind, self-doubt, habits, collaboration, and rules. The opening chapter, 'Everyone is a Creator,' includes rearranging rooms, solving problems, and engaging in conversations within the scope of creation; Rubin describes the artist's lifestyle as a practice of attention, emphasizing the connection between perception, filtering information, and forming experiences. 全书由 78 篇思考组成，话题涉及初学者心态、自我怀疑、习惯、合作与规则。开篇「人人都是创作者」把重新布置房间、解决问题、开展对话也纳入创造的范围；鲁宾将艺术家的生活方式描述为一种注意力实践，强调感知、过滤信息与形成经验之间的联系。

The original English work, 'The Creative Act: A Way of Being,' was published in 2023. The Chinese version, translated by Zhong Qing, will be released by CITIC Press Group in April 2025, totaling 416 pages. Rubin has collaborated with musicians such as Adele, Jay-Z, and Johnny Cash, transforming his music production experience into reflections on the creative process. 英文原作 The Creative Act: A Way of Being 于 2023 年出版。中文版由重轻翻译，中信出版集团于 2025 年 4 月推出，共 416 页。鲁宾曾与阿黛尔、Jay-Z、Johnny Cash 等音乐人合作，他将音乐制作经验转化为围绕创作过程的思考。

item.title: 游戏推荐｜《沉星之序》
item.guid: 游戏推荐｜《沉星之序》
item.description:
Jonathan Blow, producer of 'Braid' and 'The Witness,' and the Thekla team present their new work, 'The Starfall Protocol.' This narrative puzzle-adventure game features over 1000 hand-designed puzzles, where players will explore four parallel worlds with different rules, gradually unlocking new characters and mechanics. 《时空幻境》《见证者》的制作人 Jonathan Blow 与 Thekla 团队带来新作《沉星之序》。这款叙事解谜冒险游戏包含超过 1000 个手工设计的谜题，玩家将在四个规则各异的平行世界里探索，逐步解锁新的角色与机制。

Queens, thieves, warriors, wizards, and even a talking boat can become playable characters. Each world has its own independent story, rules, and dangers; as characters meet and worlds converge, previously separate abilities and puzzle mechanics will combine. Players can explore at their own pace, return to different worlds at any time, and piece together the story through scattered notes. 女王、盗贼、战士、巫师，甚至一艘会说话的小船，都可以成为可操控角色。每个世界有独立的故事、规则和危险；随着角色相遇、世界交汇，原本分开的能力与解谜机制也会相互组合。玩家可以按自己的节奏探索，随时返回不同世界，并通过散落的笔记拼出故事。

The game is published by Arc Games and Gamirror Games and was released on Steam on October 8th, supporting Windows PC and offering Simplified Chinese interface and subtitles. Chinese voice acting is planned to be updated approximately one month after release. As of October 11th, the overall rating on Steam is 'Overwhelmingly Positive'. 游戏由 Arc Games 与 Gamirror Games 发行，已于 10 月 8 日登陆 Steam，支持 Windows PC，提供简体中文界面和字幕。中文配音计划在发售后约一个月更新。截至 10 月 11 日，Steam 总体评价为「好评如潮」。
